results.prompt: Apply the plan a bounded growth experiment guide to the supplied classroom example. Produce the most useful draft, plan or review for this task in under 180 words. Use only supplied facts; identify missing evidence.
results.output: This experiment tests if adding a simple room-measuring checklist increases the quote rate. The measure will be the ratio of quotes to inquiries, with a baseline of 25%. The change involves placing the checklist beside the quote request form. The observation window is two weeks, tracking inquiry-to-quote conversion. A guardrail ensures the form remains functional and compliant; it must not contain unsupported claims, and delivery capacity remains unverified. The stop rule mandates reviewing if form functionality or message clarity is compromised. Missing evidence includes current inquiry-to-quote conversion rates beyond baseline, precise delivery constraints, and customer feedback. Human review should verify if the checklist simplifies inquiry qualification without introducing unsupported promises or reducing form usability.
